question: Find the value of (a - 2x)³ + (b - 2x)³ + (c - 2x)³ - 3(a - 2x)(b - 2x)(c - 2x), given that a + b + c = 6x.
solution:
**Formula:**

a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c) × (a² + b² +c² -ab -bc -ac)

**Calculation:**

The expression (a - 2x)3 + (b - 2x)3 + (c - 2x)3 - 3(a - 2x)(b - 2x)(c - 2x) could be rearranged as-

⇒ (a - 2x + b - 2x + c - 2x) × {(a - 2x)² + (b - 2x)² + (c -2x)² - (a - 2x)(b - 2x) - (b - 2x)(c - 2x) - (c - 2x)(a - 2x)}

⇒ (a + b + c - 6x) × {(a - 2x)2 + (b - 2x)2 + (c -2x)2 - (a - 2x)(b - 2x) - (b - 2x)(c - 2x) - (c - 2x)(a - 2x)}

Substituting the value of a + b + c as 6x

⇒ (6x - 6x) × {(a - 2x)2 + (b - 2x)2 + (c -2x)2 - (a - 2x)(b - 2x) - (b - 2x)(c - 2x) - (c - 2x)(a - 2x)} = 0

∴** The value of the expression is 0.**
